description: This file defines a callback class 'CocoEval' for performing COCO evaluation during training epochs in a TensorFlow/Keras-based object detection pipeline. It imports external evaluation functions and integrates with TensorFlow's summary writer for logging metrics.

classes.name: CocoEval
classes.description: A Keras callback for performing COCO evaluation at the end of each training epoch.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CocoEval callback with generator, optional tensorboard, and threshold parameters.

methods.name: on_epoch_end
methods.description: Performs COCO evaluation at the end of an epoch, updates logs, and optionally writes results to TensorBoard.
